verdict.rationale: SerpApi has its own per-API parameter reference docs, including markdown versions, plus code examples. It also mentions a "script builder to get you started quickly," which hints at an interactive example generator, but nothing confirms an in-browser playground where examples actually run. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, evidence that examples are runnable from the docs, an OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and hands-on corroboration.
